shots.focal_element: Three-line headline statement with hand-drawn doodle accents (burst marks top-left, looping arrow under 'experiences')
shots.transition_other: opening shot; no incoming transition (anchors give null)
on_screen_text: Behavioral data is transforming today's digital experiences.
shots.typography: Large left-aligned three-line sentence-case statement in a geometric sans; 'Behavioral data' set in extra-bold with a quirky stylised 'r'/'a' display cut, remaining words in regular weight; normal tracking, generous leading. Lines appear to resolve from faded to full opacity at the start. Font guess (low confidence): a custom brand grotesk.
shots.what_happens: On a soft gradient background the headline is already present and resolves from partially faded to full contrast by 0.5 s; from about 1.0 s a hand-drawn burst draws on beside 'Behavioral' and a looping squiggle arrow draws on under 'experiences', then the frame holds while the VO (w0-w9) says the line, which differs slightly from the on-screen copy ('Access to customer behavioral data is...').
shots.build_rebuild: Render a centred three-line text block with the first two words in an extra-bold weight, fade lines in over 0.4 s, then animate two SVG doodle paths (burst strokes and a looping arrow) with stroke-dashoffset draw-on over about 0.8 s and hold.

shots.focal_element: Two live-action shoppers (Alex and Sam) seated at a shared black desk with laptops, separated by a thin vertical divider
shots.what_happens: The headline from s001 scales up past camera with heavy blur, revealing two cut-out live-action people behind it; the camera then pushes in slightly on the split-screen pair as the VO introduces them (w10-w13, 'Enter Alex and Sam').
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the previous text layer from 1 to about 4 with an increasing gaussian blur and fading opacity over about 0.5 s while the footage layer underneath scales from 0.9 to 1, then apply a slow 1.0 to 1.05 push-in on the two-up split composition.

shots.shot_type_other: live-action presenters composited under recreated browser UI mockups
shots.focal_element: Two identical recreated browser windows for a fictional sneaker shop, floating above each shopper
shots.transition_other: browser mockups appear over the continuing split-screen footage (layered reveal rather than a cut)
shots.typography: Browser chrome text in small system sans; hero headline 'Sneakers Built for Life' in a large condensed rounded sans, mixed case, set in white over the hero photo; section label 'SHOP THE COLLECTIONS' in small all-caps with wide tracking. Collection tile labels are too small to read reliably on the sheet.
shots.what_happens: A browser window sits above each shopper showing the same store homepage; both pages scroll down in parallel from the hero to a 'Shop the collections' tile row while separate cursors hover different tiles, illustrating 'avid online shoppers on the same site' (w14-w23).
shots.build_rebuild: Place two identical browser-window mockups (rounded card with soft drop shadow) above each half of the split footage and animate their inner page content scrolling up by the same distance over about 2 s with an ease-in-out, each with its own animated cursor sprite.

shots.shot_type_other: live-action presenters composited under recreated browser UI mockups
shots.focal_element: Two different product-grid pages ('White Sneakers' vs 'Elevated Classics') showing each shopper's divergent path
shots.typography: Category headings in bold all-caps condensed sans with slight tracking; product names in small mixed-case condensed sans with prices beneath in regular weight; URLs in tiny browser-chrome sans. The fourth product label on the right is partly hidden by the cursor and not quoted.
shots.what_happens: Both browser pages crossfade through a blank loading state into category grids of colourful product photos; the left shopper lands on a white-sneakers grid and the right on an elevated-classics grid, the grids scroll and the cursors move between products while the VO says 'the same product at the same time' (w24-w29).
shots.build_rebuild: Crossfade each browser's content from a pale skeleton page to a 4-column product grid over about 0.4 s, then scroll the grid up slowly and move each cursor along a short bezier path to hover a product card.

shots.shot_type_other: live-action presenter composited under a large recreated e-commerce UI walkthrough
shots.focal_element: One large browser window with the 'Athena 1' product page, with a single shopper seated beneath and a coloured glow halo behind them that signals success or frustration
shots.transition_other: split-screen collapses into a single centred panel focused on one shopper (layout reframe)
on_screen_text: Your go-to for comfort and easy styling. Rock this classic sneaker for any occasion.
shots.typography: Store logo as a two-weight all-caps wordmark (bold 'TREAD' plus light 'WAVE'); product title in bold all-caps condensed sans with bold price right-aligned; body copy in small light mixed-case sans; buttons in small bold sans inside pill shapes; accordion rows in all-caps condensed sans; confirmation headline in bold all-caps. The red error label, cart totals and search results are small on the sheets and read with medium confidence.
shots.what_happens: The split collapses to the woman (Alex, named by the 'Thank you, Alex!' page) under a large product page: she opens the size dropdown, picks a size, clicks Add to Cart (button shows a loading state then 'Added'), opens the cart and checks out to a thank-you page while a soft success-toned glow blooms behind her. A fast horizontal slide with motion blur at about 20.5 s switches to the man (Sam) on the same page: he picks a size, clicks Add to Cart, gets an 'Unable to confirm availability' error, the glow behind him turns an alarm tone, he opens a new tab, searches Google for 'athena 1 sneakers', returns, then throws up his hands and the page spins on a loader. VO covers w30-w65 ('Despite all their similarities ... What made Alex convert and Sam lose interest?').
shots.build_rebuild: Build one browser-mockup component with scripted states (product page, size dropdown, button loading/added, cart, confirmation, error pill, search page, spinner) driven by a cursor timeline, place a cut-out presenter video beneath it, and animate a blurred radial-gradient glow behind the presenter whose opacity and hue tween between a success and an error colour token on each outcome.
